verses.text: Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Ab'ek wal tas syal Jehová: Ha k'ik'an yab' icha tik, ha t'a spuertail Samaria tik, a junok almul ixim harina, jun ciclo plata stojol ixim. Chab' almul pax ixim cebada t'a jun ciclo k'een, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi jun winh stanhwan winh rey chi' icha tik: --Wach'chom sjakwi swentenail satcha'anh yuj Jehová, palta max ujilaj icha tzal chi', xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Olto il wal jun chi', palta manhxo ol a walaj ixim, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay chanhwanh heb' winh ayoch lepra t'ay, ayel heb' winh t'a stiel chonhab' chi', ix yal-lan heb' winh t'ay junjun: --¿Tas wal sko k'ulej t'a tik? Tonhej k'ojan onh em ko tanhwan cham ko b'a.

Tato tzonh och t'a yol chonhab' tik, yowalil tzonh cham yuj wejel. Tato tzonh kan k'ojan t'a tik, yowalil ol onh champaxok. Ha tiknaik koyek t'a scampamento heb' sirio, talaj tzonh yak' niwank'olal heb', max onh smil-laj heb'. Tato maay jun, toxonton yik chamel kaji, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik numnonxo sq'uik'b'i, ix b'at heb' winh t'a scampamento heb' sirio chi'. Haxo ix k'och heb' winh, ix yilan heb' winh manhxa junok mach ayeq'ui.

Yujto a Jehová ix ak'an yab' heb' soldado sirio sk'anh yek' carruaje yet' nok' chej yet' pax jun niwan nhilanh soldado. Ha yalan heb' sirio chi' to a winh sreyal heb' israel ix tupan heb' winh sreyal hitita yet' winh sreyal Egipto yik syak'an owal yet' heb' yalani.
Yuj chi' ayik wan sq'uik'b'i ix b'at heb' elelal, ix yaktankan scampamento heb' yet' smantiado yet' nok' chej yet' scarruaje heb'. Anhej heb' ix skol sb'a.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh ayoch lepra chi' t'ay t'a stitak campamento chi', ix och heb' winh t'a yol junok mantiado, ix wa heb' winh, ix yuk'an ha' heb' winh. Ix yik'anelta k'een oro heb' winh, k'een plata yet' pichul, ix b'at heb' winh sk'ub'ejeli. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh, ix ochxi heb' winh t'a yol junxo mantiado, ix yik'anelta heb' winh tastak ay t'a yool, ix b'atxi heb' winh sk'ub'ejeli.

Ix laj yalan heb' winh t'ay junjun: --Manh wach'ok jun wan ko k'ulan tik. Ha tiknaik smoj wal kik'anb'at ab'ix, palta ichnhejta' kajeq'ui. Tato sko tanhwej, hato k'ik'an b'at kala', ay ta tas skot t'a kib'anh. Wach' to b'at kalek t'a winh rey, xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh, ix yawtan heb' winh stanhwumal sti' chonhab' chi' heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Ix onh xit'ek' t'a scampamento heb' sirio, manhxa junok mach ayeq'ui, manhxa junok mach skab' sloloni, haxonhej nok' chej yet' nok' b'uru etzjab'kani. Haxo smantiado heb', icha ix aj sb'oankan heb', icha chi' yajkani.
Ix b'at heb' winh stanhwumal sti' chonhab' chi' yawtej heb' winh stanhwan spalacio winh rey.

Ix alji yab' winh rey chi', yuj chi' ix k'e waan winh t'ak'walil chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh ayoch t'a opisio yet'ok: --Ol wal t'ayex tas snib'ej heb' sirio chi' tzonh yutej, yujto yojtak heb' to wan ko cham yuj wejel, yuj chi' ix yaktejkan scampamento heb' chi', ix sk'ub'anel sb'a heb' t'a kaltak te', yuj chi' tato tzonh el t'a spatikel chonhab' tik, ol onh syam heb' t'a pitzanil, haxo yochkankot heb' t'a yol chonhab' tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan junok heb' winh schekab' winh icha tik: --B'atokab' jaywanhok winak yila' yet' owanhok nok' chej ayto ek' tik, ol kilani tas ix uji chi'. Tato scham heb', mato maay, lajannhej, yujto ay smay b'aj sb'at heb' chi', ay pax smay t'a tik, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at chab' carruaje heb' yet' nok' chej, ix chekjib'at heb' yuj winh rey chi', yik b'at yil heb' b'ajtil ix b'at heb' sirio chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: B'at ilek tas wal yaji, xchi winh.

Ix b'at tzak'an heb' t'a yoklem heb' sirio chi', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a ha' Jordán. Ix yilan heb' to aykan spichul heb' t'a yoltak b'e yet' syamk'ab' heb' ayik wan yel heb' skol sb'a yalani. Elanhchamel ix meltzaj heb' chekab' chi', ix ul yalan heb' t'a winh rey chi' tas ix yil heb' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix elta masanil heb' anima t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix yik'anelta masanil tastak ay t'a yol scampamento heb' sirio chi' heb', ix yik'ankot heb'. Ix elk'och icha ix aj yalan Jehová, a jun almul ixim harina, jun ciclo plata stojol ixim. Chab' almul pax ixim cebada t'a jun ciclo plata chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey t'a winh stanhwumal to skan winh stanhwej spuertail chonhab' chi', palta ix b'at heb' anima t'a yib'anh winh, ix telwikan winh t'a skal yok heb', ix cham winh, icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios t'a winh ayik ix xit'ek' winh rey lolonel yet' winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ix elk'och icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' to ha t'a spuertail chonhab' Samaria yab' icha tik k'ik'an, schonhchaj ixim harina, a jun almul ixim, jun ciclo plata stojol. Chab' almul pax ixim cebada t'a jun ciclo k'een, xchi winh.

Haxo jun winh stanhwumal winh rey chi', ix tak'wi winh t'a winh schekab' Dios chi': Wach'chom sjakwi swentenail satcha'anh yuj Jehová, palta max ujilaj icha tzal chi', xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo: Olto il wal jun chi', palta manhxo ol a walaj ixim, xchi winh.
Ichaton chi' ix aji, yujto a heb' anima ix tek'ancham winh t'a spuertail chonhab' chi'.
